title: Specification of fixed-width increment
statement: For every Boolean word $u$, if its fixed-width increment is a word $v$, then $v$ has the same length as $u$ and its little-endian value is the value of $u$ plus one. If the increment has no result, then the value of $u$ plus one equals $2^{|u|}$.
replaced:
For every boolean word $u$: if the fixed-width increment of $u$ succeeds with
result $v$, then $|v| = |u|$ and the little-endian value of $v$ is one more than
that of $u$; if it overflows, then the value of $u$ plus one equals $2^{|u|}$.
